checks.name: Zero Orphan Payment Attempts
checks.description: Every payment attempt must reference an existing transaction.
checks.query:
SELECT pa.id, pa.transaction_id
        FROM payment_attempts pa
        LEFT JOIN transactions t ON pa.transaction_id = t.id
        WHERE t.id IS NULL;

checks.name: Financial Arithmetic Invariants
checks.query:
SELECT id, authorized_minor, captured_minor, refunded_minor, reserved_refund_minor
        FROM transactions
        WHERE captured_minor > authorized_minor 
           OR (refunded_minor + reserved_refund_minor) > captured_minor;

checks.name: Audit Ledger Trigger Active
checks.description: Trigger trg_state_log_immutable must be enabled on transaction_state_log.
checks.query:
SELECT tgname, relname, tgenabled
        FROM pg_trigger tg
        JOIN pg_class cl ON tg.tgrelid = cl.oid
        WHERE cl.relname = 'transaction_state_log' 
          AND tg.tgname = 'trg_state_log_immutable';

checks.name: Composite Idempotency Uniqueness
checks.description: Zero duplicate (merchant_id, operation, key) rows in idempotency_keys.
checks.query:
SELECT merchant_id, operation, key, COUNT(*) as cnt
        FROM idempotency_keys
        GROUP BY merchant_id, operation, key
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

checks.name: Single Active Attempt Invariant
checks.description: No transaction may have more than one concurrent active attempt.
checks.query:
SELECT transaction_id, COUNT(*) as active_cnt
        FROM payment_attempts
        WHERE status IN ('CREATED', 'SENT', 'UNKNOWN')
        GROUP BY transaction_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

checks.name: Legal State Log Transitions
checks.description: Zero identical from_state = to_state rows unless explicitly permitted.
checks.query:
SELECT id, transaction_id, from_state, to_state, event
        FROM transaction_state_log
        WHERE event NOT IN ('REJECTED_TRANSITION', 'OUT_OF_ORDER_RESOLUTION', 'SETTLEMENT_INVESTIGATION_LOGGED')
          AND from_state = to_state
          AND from_state IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: No Stale Expired PROCESSING Keys
checks.description: Zero idempotency keys in PROCESSING status past expiration.

checks.name: Webhook Ingestion Deduplication
checks.description: Zero duplicate (gateway, event_id) rows in processed_webhook_events.
checks.query:
SELECT gateway, event_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
        FROM processed_webhook_events
        GROUP BY gateway, event_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

checks.name: Zero Negative Monetary Values
checks.description: All monetary fields must be non-negative integers.
checks.query:
SELECT id, amount_minor, authorized_minor, captured_minor, refunded_minor
        FROM transactions
        WHERE amount_minor < 0 
           OR authorized_minor < 0 
           OR captured_minor < 0 
           OR refunded_minor < 0 
           OR reserved_refund_minor < 0;

checks.name: Captures and Refunds Foreign Key Consistency
checks.description: Zero dangling capture or refund records.
checks.query:
SELECT c.id
        FROM capture_operations c
        LEFT JOIN transactions t ON c.transaction_id = t.id
        WHERE t.id IS NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT r.id
        FROM refunds r
        LEFT JOIN transactions t ON r.transaction_id = t.id
        WHERE t.id IS NULL;
